milestoneContract.title: V6 PKG-E explicit checksum-verified Electron binary provisioning
milestoneContract.objective: Provision the Electron binary through a single explicit, checksum-verified, protected installer step outside node_modules and make the Desktop/Control Tower smokes launch only that verified binary, using only Founder-authorized changes.
requirements: [V6-PKG-E-ELECTRON-PROVISIONING-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.rule] A new protected step, called by the installer, downloads electron-v44.4.5-win32-x64.zip from GitHub releases. Its SHA-256 is verified against checksums.json inside the locked package. The binary is extracted outside node_modules under .ai/cache/electron and the smokes verify it there before launching. The installed-tree seal is not broken; the download happens only in this step.

[V6-PKG-E-ELECTRON-PROVISIONING-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.protectedFiles] scripts/provision-electron.mjs, automation/lib/electron-provision.mjs, automation/lib/electron-provision.d.mts, scripts/smoke-desktop.mjs, scripts/smoke-control-tower.mjs, scripts/install.ps1, config/protected-paths.json

[V6-PKG-E-ELECTRON-PROVISIONING-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.constraint] Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical validation (config/validation.json) passes on the exact reviewed commit on Windows with Node >=24 and npm >=11, and the checkpoint records the measured validation environment.

The provisioning step verifies the installed-tree seal, downloads only through https GitHub hosts with manually checked redirects, verifies the zip SHA-256 against the locked package's checksums.json before extraction, extracts without a shell into staging outside node_modules and places it atomically.
Both smokes launch Electron only after verifying the provisioning manifest, dist/version, a regular-file executable and the recorded executable SHA-256, never download, and fail closed otherwise.
The installer runs the provisioning step immediately before the Control Tower smoke, and the new step is part of the protected trust root.
Only the Founder-authorized protected files change, the installed-tree seal remains intact after provisioning, and no existing test assertion, validator or policy is weakened.
